name: doc-sync
description: After code changes, identifies documentation that may be outdated (README.md, AGENTS.md, API docs, etc.) and flags them for review or auto-updates.
author: Qwen Code AI Engineering

afterTurn: After modifying source code files, check if related documentation files reference the modified code patterns. If a README, AGENTS.md, or API doc mentions the old function names, parameters, or behavior, flag it with a 'doc drift' warning listing the specific sections that need updating.
